content:
maria: Heads-up — shelf-22 in eu-west1 showing persistent fragmentation; ~18% usable Dedicated capacity lost.

devon: saw increased 99p for some tenants this AM, likely placement holes.

anil: no scheduler deploys recently. telemetry shows many short-lived allocs (5-30s) leaving tiny holes.

maria: quick metric snapshot: shelf=22 total=64 free=12 fragmented=11 loss=0.18 short_rate=40/m

lucy: propose a tiny compaction canary: dry-run -> soft-drain -> migrate ephemerals to warmpool, prefer live migration.

anil: SLO-driven plan: trigger when fragment_loss>0.12; egress precheck (post-move <70% iface); abort if 99p latency regresses >3x.

devon: rollback = stop compactor, reprovision with previous weights, enable 1h burst for impacted tenants, 30m cooldown per rack.

maria: ops-bot create incident and checklist. keep canary to one rack and notify tenants T-1h.

ops-bot: created INC-2026-1378 with checklist: dry-run artifacts, 1-rack canary, egress checks, 2h watch, rollback steps. :white_check_mark:

lucy: I'll draft the customer note after dry-run output.

devon: log everything with trace_id=frag-1768099999 and include before/after placement snapshots.

anil: dry-run command: ./compactor --shelf 22 --rack 3 --dry-run --trace-id frag-1768099999

maria: thanks — keep the window small and watch 99p + egress. ping if red flags.
